utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Liam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Amira Varga. I’ve been charged unarranged overdraft fees and I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry, Amira. I can see there’s a £30 unarranged overdraft fee on your account from 14 October, and your balance is £42 overdrawn.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s right. I don’t think those fees are fair, and nobody explained them to me.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand why you’re upset. I’ll get that £30 refunded for you, and I’ll make sure we look into what happened.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I’d appreciate that. I’ve already called once and didn’t get a clear answer.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you had to chase us. Before I take this further, could you confirm your full name, date of birth and first line of address?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Amira Varga, 12 March 1991, 18 Willow Lane, Bristol.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. That matches our records. I’m logging this as a complaint about the unarranged overdraft fee and the explanation you received. Your reference is TB-684217.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll send this to our complaints team today and include the fee and your previous call. I’ll personally check that it’s been passed on by Friday, 25 October, and let you know if anything’s delayed.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And when will I get an answer?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’ll receive a full written response within eight weeks of today. It’ll explain what we found and what we’re doing about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: So, I’ve logged your complaint, I’m passing it to the complaints team today, and I’ll check the handover by 25 October. You’ll have the full written response within eight weeks. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that’s clear. Thanks for taking it seriously.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Amira. I’m sorry again about the frustration, and I’ll make sure that follow-up is done.
